data.name: Pinterest-native creative v7 daily outbound test
data.objective: Forward-test one current verified catalog product with a product-specific editorial mechanism and a unique canonical tracked destination.
data.hypothesis: Showing the exact Butt Station organizer literally dispensing tape on a serious architecture desk will create a useful-first, strange-second double take and a credible reason to click through to the exact product.
successCriteria: Two visually distinct executions are compared and no more than one survivor advances.
The survivor passes every hard gate, averages at least 4.0, has no score below 3, and preserves every identity-defining product part.
Any public production write uses the verified goosegifts BUSINESS account, a unique tracked canonical destination, durable receipt, and API readback.
constraints: Generate no more than one genuinely excellent survivor and revise only a diagnosed weakness.
Never spend, use Sandbox, or treat Pinterest v3 as traffic evidence.
One public Pin maximum for the calendar day and only after the exact complete package is approved.
